source.author: stat
source.text: mirum unde, sed olim hic honor alitibus, superae seu conditor aulae sic dedit effusum chaos in nova semina texens, seu quia mutatae nostraque ab origine versis corporibus subiere notos, seu purior axis amotumque nefas et rarum insistere terris vera docent; tibi, summe sator terraeque deumque, scire licet, nos Argolicae primordia pugnae venturumque sinas caelo praenosse laborem.
source.text_original: mirum unde, sed olim / hic honor alitibus, superae seu conditor aulae / sic dedit effusum chaos in nova semina texens, / seu quia mutatae nostraque ab origine versis / corporibus subiere notos, seu purior axis / amotumque nefas et rarum insistere terris / vera docent; tibi, summe sator terraeque deumque, / scire licet, nos Argolicae primordia pugnae / venturumque sinas caelo praenosse laborem.
source.text_english: It is strange whence, but long ago this honor was granted to birds, whether the founder of the heavenly palace so bestowed it, weaving the outpouring chaos into new seeds, or because they were changed and, with bodies turned, came beneath our sky from their original source, or because the purer axis and the removed crime and the rare act of treading the earth teach what is true; it is for you, highest creator of earth and gods, to know, to whom it is permitted to know beforehand the beginnings of the Argolic war and to know in advance the toil that is to come from heaven.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_original: 'summie sator, cui nostra dies volventibus annis / tot peragit reficitque vices, tuane ista voluntas?
reuse.text_english: Supreme creator, whose day with the years rolling on carries out and renews so many turns for us, is this your will?
